newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures close slightly down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures close slightly down.

text.p: Wheat futures continued to edge down on the Sydney Futures Exchange on Wednesday as the market remained in bearish mood.
January 1997 fell by 50 cents to A$146.50 on 13 trades while March 1997 sold steady at A$149.00 on five traded lots.
Matt Kirk of McIntosh Futures Ltd said there was a lot of jockeying around with the potential for December Chicago wheat to find a temporary base at US$3.80 a bushel.
January 1997 was attracting increased put option interest while some players were interested in buying March A$150.00 call options, he said.
"They're starting to get some good two-way business," he said. The falling market had some traders chasing it down, while buyers were emerging at present levels, he said.
Kirk believes that if the Chicago December contract breaches $3.80 it may fall to $3.65. This would bring SFE January wheat to A$135.00, he said.
Many stops placed on the January contract at A$140.00 also suggested a next level of about A$135.00, he said.
